slides.headline: How to trade a market holiday, in [3 numbers]

slides.title: 1. Wall Street shuts 10 days a year
paras: Today is one: US stocks are closed for Thanksgiving. So, 251 trading days in 2026. Bitcoin trades all <g>365</g>.
slides.source: NYSE holiday calendar 2026 (10 full closures; 261 weekdays - 10 = 251)

slides.title: 2. This week in UTC+8 time
slides.text: Friday is a [half day] in New York: closes 1 PM ET.

slides.title: 3. Crypto still moves on Thanksgiving
paras: Bitcoin on Thanksgiving Day, vs the day before. 2020: <r>-8.4%</r> while Wall Street was closed. Past data, not a promise.

sources: NYSE Holidays & Trading Hours (nyse.com) + ICE press release (2026-2028 holiday calendar) + Fidelity/Kiplinger 2026 lists: 10 full closures in 2026 (Jan 1, Jan 19, Feb 16, Apr 3, May 25, Jun 19, Jul 3, Sep 7, Nov 26, Dec 25); early close 1:00 pm ET Fri Nov 27 and Thu Dec 24. 261 weekdays in 2026 - 10 = 251 trading days
1:00 pm ET (EST, UTC-5) Fri Nov 27 = 18:00 UTC = 02:00 Sat Nov 28 UTC+8
